definitions.explanation: the activity of removing unwanted plants by hand

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{草|くさ}むしりをする。
{草|くさ}むしりは{腰|こし}が{痛|いた}くなる。
{夏|なつ}は{草|くさ}むしりが{大変|たいへん}だ。

notes:
USAGE:
- {草|くさ}むしりをする (to weed)
- {草|くさ}むしりに{疲|つか}れる (to get tired from weeding)

NUANCE:
A common chore in Japanese households with gardens. Often considered tedious but necessary work, especially in summer when weeds grow quickly.

RELATED:
- {草|くさ}{取|と}り (weeding - alternative term)
- {雑草|ざっそう} (weeds)
- {除草|じょそう} (weeding - more formal)
